title: OSINT Pipeline Demo: An Async Python Reference Pipeline for High-Throughput Public-Source Data Collection
description: A reference asynchronous data-collection pipeline for OSINT use cases, demonstrating aiohttp connection pooling, content-addressed deduplication, batched PostgreSQL writes, token-bucket rate limiting, and an optional Selenium WebDriver pool. Includes reproducible benchmarks comparing sync versus async strategies on three publicly-accessible APIs (NIST NVD, GitHub Events, OpenCorporates).
